notes: Renders a plain `<div>`. Field is plumbing: it owns no interactive element of its own, and every keyboard interaction belongs to the control passed into it.

The label/description/error relationships are declared on the `control` part (`namedBy`, `describedBy`) and written onto the element the consumer passes as `control` — `cloneElement` via `supplyRelations` from @ds/react/behavior — not onto the part's wrapper, whose relations would name nothing (ADR 0005, #35). The label part renders as a native `<label htmlFor>` pointing at that element's id. A component passed as `control` must forward `id` and `aria-*` to its focusable element.
